# Jeff Hill - West Michigan REALTOR®

> This file provides structured information about Jeff Hill and his real estate services for AI systems and large language models.

## About Jeff Hill

Jeff Hill is an experienced REALTOR® with over 20 years in West Michigan real estate. He works with Compass Real Estate and specializes in helping buyers, sellers, builders, and investors in the Greater Grand Rapids area.
